cases.name: etaf-playground-mount-rejects-unknown-example
cases.purpose: An unknown example fails explicitly without publishing preview content.

cases.name: etaf-playground-mounts-preloaded-research-companion
cases.purpose: A directly loaded source or compiled Research Shelf companion mounts repeatedly without duplicate Action registration and its Reload control remains functional.

cases.name: etaf-playground-mounts-static-rule-companion-in-fresh-emacs
cases.purpose: Research Shelf mounts, filters, paginates and switches light/dark themes through public APIs with its scoped ECSS companion and an isolated database.

cases.name: etaf-playground-mounts-desktop-with-provider-feature-loaded
cases.purpose: Mounting the desktop example works when the etaf-desktop provider feature is already loaded, so the companion still registers and builds its root instead of falling back to a missing etaf-desktop-root.

cases.name: etaf-playground-consumes-etaf-desktop-application
cases.purpose: The Playground mounts the independent ETAF Desktop application as a consumer and releases it through the public workspace lifecycle.
